abilities.name: Abyssal Presence
abilities.description: The area within 60 feet of this Pokémon is considered difficult terrain for creatures it chooses. Additionally, dim light within this area is treated as darkness.

effects.note: Creatures it chooses; the area moves with it.
Dim light within the area counts as darkness.

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.description: When this Pokémon uses a move of its own type, it may roll the damage twice and choose either total.

abilities.name: Adaptive Cells
abilities.description: At the start of its turn, this Pokémon can gain resistance to one damage type it was damaged by since its last turn. This lasts until it uses this ability again.

ends.text: until it uses this ability again

abilities.name: Aftermath
abilities.description: This Pokémon deals damage to an attacker equal to half of the damage received when knocked out by a melee move.

abilities.name: Air Lock
abilities.description: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather-related abilities have no effect on the Pokémon that have them.

abilities.name: Amorphous
abilities.description: This Pokémon can move through spaces that are as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

abilities.name: Analytic
abilities.description: After this Pokémon misses an attack, its next attack is done at advantage.

abilities.name: Ancient Connection
abilities.description: While this Pokémon is within 60ft. of an ancient artifact, it gains advantage on WIS saving throws.

while.text: within 60 ft of an ancient artifact

abilities.name: Ancient Ward
abilities.description: This Pokémon gains resistance to Cosmic type damage, and can predict stellar events that will happen within a 5 mile radius. Within the same area it is able to sense when Cosmic, Psychic, Ghost or Dark energy is used.

effects.note: Out of combat: predicts stellar events, senses Cosmic/Psychic/Ghost/Dark energy within 5 miles.

abilities.name: Anger Point
abilities.description: After suffering a critical hit, this Pokémon doubles the damage dice for a single move it activates on the following turn.

effects.note: One move on its following turn.

abilities.name: Anticipation
abilities.description: When this Pokémon enters the battle, an opponent must reveal if it has a move that the Pokémon is vulnerable to. The move does not have to be revealed - only that there is such a move.

effects.note: Only WHETHER it has a move this Pokemon is vulnerable to -- not which move.

abilities.name: Aqua Camoflauge
abilities.description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon gains temporary hit points equal to its level when battling in coastal and swampy areas, or in rainy conditions

abilities.name: Arena Trap
abilities.description: Grounded creatures within 50 feet of this Pokémon may not flee or switch out, except by item, Move, or ability.

effects.note: Can still leave by item, move or ability.

review.question: "Grounded creatures within 50 ft" -- does that include its own allies, or only opponents?

abilities.name: Aroma Veil
abilities.description: Any ally within 15 feet of this Pokémon automatically passes any WIS save they are required to make.

abilities.name: Aura Break
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is in battle, the boost of Fairy Aura and Dark Aura abilities is reversed, Any applicable move type activated within 100 feet deals half damage instead of double.

effects.note: Dark Aura and Fairy Aura halve their moves instead of doubling them.

abilities.name: Bad Dreams
abilities.description: If an opponent in battle with this Pokémon falls asleep, they take an amount of damage equal to this Pokémon's proficeincy bonus at the end of each of their turns.

effects.note: Every sleeping opponent in battle, at the end of each of ITS turns.

abilities.name: Balance Keeper
abilities.description: At the end of every turn, revert any stat changes in effect. For every instance nullified, regain 2d10 of either HP or VP.

effects.note: 2d10 HP or VP for every stat change it reverted.

review.question: "At the end of every turn, revert any stat changes" -- only its own stat changes, or every creature's? Every creature's turn, or only its own?

abilities.name: Battery
abilities.description: Allies that activate electric-type moves within 20 feet of this Pokémon double their damage dice.

abilities.name: Battle Armor
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to extra damage dealt by a Critical Hit.

abilities.name: Battle Tactics
abilities.description: This Pokémon gains an additional action when its hit points drop below 50% of its maximum.

review.question: One extra action every turn while below 50% HP, or a single extra action when it first drops below?

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.description: Upon causing an opponent to faint, this Pokémon increases the ability scores of its saving throw proficiencies by 2 until the end of combat. This is stackable up to a maximum of +10 to any one ability score.

effects.note: The ability scores of its saving-throw proficiencies; max +10 to any one score.

abilities.name: Berry Sense
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on Perception checks to locate berry plants, and can identify berry types by their flowers alone.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: When this Pokémon falls below 25% of its maximum health, all of its attacks are rolled with disadvantage, but deal double their damage. If a move activated requires a saving throw, the target(s) have advantage on the roll.

abilities.name: Between Worlds
abilities.description: As a bonus action, this Pokémon can phase partially into the Depths of Twilight, gaining resistance to all damage except psychic and fairy until the start of its next turn.

abilities.name: Big Pecks
abilities.description: This Pokémon's AC cannot be reduced by an opponent's moves.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: When this Pokémon falls below 25% of its maximum HP, add 50% more dice to damage rolls for its fire-type moves, and damaging fire moves cost 50% more VP.

abilities.name: Bloodhound
abilities.description: This Pokémon can detect living creatures within a 90ft range. It gets advantage on perception checks to locate living creatures in range, and can't suffer reduced accuracy when attacking living creatures.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to damage from moves with Bullet, Ball, or Bomb in their name.

abilities.name: Burrower
abilities.description: This Pokémon can burrow underground traveling a distance equal to its walking speed before re-emerging.

abilities.name: Cacophony
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to sound-based moves.

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on Stealth checks while in its natural habitat, or in a fitting habitat (GM's discretion).

abilities.name: Centurion's Honor
abilities.description: This Pokémon can be wielded as a +2 longsword, dealing 2d6 + STR steel type damage. While equipped, grants the wielder proficiency in longswords if they don't already have it. When wielded, grants +2 AC, and allows the user to channel the Pokémon's moves as a bonus action, using the Pokémon's ability scores. Additionally, the wielder gains resistance to ghost type damage. It can also manifest a spectral cape behind its wielder, granting it advantage on intimidation rolls. If separated from its chosen wielder, will teleport back to them as a bonus action. While bonded, trainer and Pokémon can communicate telepathically within 120 feet. If the trainer is knocked unconscious, this Pokémon automatically detaches and fights to protect them.

abilities.name: Cheek Pouch
abilities.description: When this Pokémon eats any type of berry, is heals for an additional 10% of its maximum HP (rounded up to the nearest whole number).

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.description: This Pokémon’s speed is doubled in harsh sunlight. In harsh sunlight, this Pokémon regenerates HP equal to its proficiency bonus at the start each turn.

abilities.name: Chronoshift
abilities.description: When this Pokémon takes damage, roll a d20. On an 18-20, it glimpses an alternate timeline and avoids the attack.

effects.note: Glimpses another timeline and avoids the attack.

abilities.name: Circuit Break
abilities.description: This Pokémon's attacks can deal electrical damage to Ground-type Pokémon.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.description: Other Pokémon's moves or abilities cannot lower this Pokémon stats.

abilities.name: Cloud Nine
abilities.description: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather-related abilities have no effect on the Pokémon that have them.

abilities.name: Colony Mind
abilities.description: This Pokémon can telepathically communicate with other members of the same species within 30 feet and has advantage on Wisdom checks when within 5 feet of another member of the same species.

abilities.name: Color Change
abilities.description: When hit by a damaging attack, this Pokémon's type changes to the type that hit it. It takes on the new type's resistances, vulnerabilities, and immunities.

effects.note: Takes on the new type's resistances, vulnerabilities and immunities.

abilities.name: Comforting Presence
abilities.description: Creatures within 10ft of this Pokémon have advantage on saves against fear.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.description: This Pokémon adds its proficiency bonus to damage rolls while poisoned, burned, confused, or paralyzed.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.description: This Pokémon gets an additional +1 to attack rolls.

abilities.name: Contrary
abilities.description: Moves that affect this Pokémon's stats have the opposite effect. (For example, Defense Curl would lower AC by 4. Growl would increase its attack by +1)

abilities.name: Corrosion
abilities.description: This Pokémon's moves ignore poison immunity, and can inflict the poisoned status on steel and poison-type Pokémon.

effects.note: Can poison steel- and poison-types.

abilities.name: Cosmic Core
abilities.description: You are immune to ground-type moves. When hit by a damaging move, roll a d12. On a roll of 8 or higher, half of the damage dealt is reflected back in a 15ft. radius as typeless damage.

effects.note: Half the damage it took, reflected around it.

abilities.name: Cosmic Slumber
abilities.description: Jirachi is always asleep. While asleep (its normal state), Jirachi regenerates 10 + 2x its proficiency modifier hit points at the start of its turn. It can still sense its surroundings and make decisions, but can only use a limited set of moves.

effects.note: Always asleep -- its normal state; it still senses, decides and uses a limited set of moves.

abilities.name: Crystal Reservoir
abilities.description: You are immune to the effects of intense heat, like heat exhaustion.

abilities.name: Curiosity
abilities.description: Moves requiring an attack roll that have not previously been used in the same encounter deal 2d10 typeless bonus damage on a hit the first time they are used.

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.description: When hit by a melee attack, this Pokémon may roll 1d4. On a result of 4, the opponent who made the attack cannot use the same move on its next turn.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.description: Once per short rest, you can impose disadvantage on an enemy attack roll of your choice.

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.description: This Pokémon is unaffected by Self Destruct and Explosion moves.

abilities.name: Dancer
abilities.description: If any creature within sight of this Pokémon activates a move with Dance in its name, this Pokémon may immediately use one of its moves as a reaction.

effects.note: Any creature it can see; it uses one of its own moves.

abilities.name: Dark Aura
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is in battle, all dark-type moves by allies or opponents within 100 feet deal double their damage.

review.question: Does it also double its own dark moves? (Fairy Aura excludes its own.)

abilities.name: Dark Native
abilities.description: This Pokémon is proficient with Dark type moves. If it is also Dark type, double its proficiency bonus.

effects.note: If it is also Dark type, double its proficiency bonus.

abilities.name: Dazzling
abilities.description: Bonus action moves activated by any creature within sight of this Pokémon become standard actions.

effects.note: Any creature it can see.

abilities.name: Defeatist
abilities.description: When this Pokémon drops below 25% of its maximum HP, all of its attacks are rolled with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is subject to a move that gives it a status condition, it has advantage on the next attack.

abilities.name: Desert Adaptation
abilities.description: This Pokémon has resistance to fire type damage regardless of typing, and suffers no penalty from extreme heat. Additionally, it is proficient with Ground type moves.

effects.note: No penalty from extreme heat.

abilities.name: Diplomat
abilities.description: This Pokémon can cast Calm Emotions once per short rest without consuming energy.

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.description: This Pokémon has a disguise which gives it a temporary hp boost equal to twice its level. When the temporary hit points fall to zero, the disguise breaks and requires a short rest to repair.

effects.note: The disguise breaks when these temporary HP reach 0; a short rest repairs it.

abilities.name: Download
abilities.description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon can choose a different damage type for one of their normal attacks.

review.question: "Normal attacks" -- normal-TYPE moves, or any ordinary attack?

abilities.name: Dream Walker
abilities.description: This Pokémon can perceive both the Material Plane and Sea of Dreams simultaneously. As an action, it can attempt to step between planes (DC 15 Wisdom check). On a success, it enters the Sea of Dreams or returns to the Material Plane. It can bring its trainer with it, but doing so increases the DC to 18. The Pokémon can't use this ability again until it completes a short or long rest.

abilities.name: Dreamscape
abilities.description: When causing a creature to fall asleep, their spirits are transported to a dreamlike plane in the mind of this Pokémon. Creatures in the Dreamscape can't wake up unless they wake the dreamer.

abilities.name: Drizzle
abilities.description: When this Pokémon enters an outside battle, the weather immediately changes to light rain for 5 rounds. In the case of another Pokémon with a similar weather ability, the tie goes to the Pokémon with the highest DEX score.

effects.name: Rain
effects.note: Ties with another weather ability go to the higher DEX score.

abilities.name: Drought
abilities.description: When this Pokémon enters an outside battle, the weather immediately changes to bright sunlight for 5 rounds. In the case of another Pokémon with a similar weather ability, the tie goes to the Pokémon with the highest DEX score.

effects.name: Harsh Sunlight
effects.note: Ties with another weather ability go to the higher DEX score.

abilities.name: Dry Skin
abilities.description: At the end of each of this Pokémon's turns, it takes an amount of damage equal to its proficiency modifier in harsh sunlight, or heals for the same amount during rain.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on rolls to wake from sleep.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.description: When hit by a melee attack, roll a d4. On a 4, deal an amount of grass damage equal to your proficiency modifier to your attacker.

abilities.name: Emberflame
abilities.description: The tips of this Pokémon’s feathers emit a constant ember-glow. While conscious, it sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. Any creature that grapples or hits this Pokémon with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 1d4 + proficiency modifier fire damage.

effects.note: Also when a creature within 5 feet grapples it.
Sheds dim light in a 10 ft radius while conscious.

abilities.name: Emergency Exit
abilities.description: At any time this Pokémon is damaged when it is at or below 50% of its maximum HP, it may disengage and move up to its speed as a free action, and its trainer may switch it out as a free action.

effects.note: Disengage + move up to its speed as a free action; its trainer may switch it out as a free action.

abilities.name: Energy Intensive
abilities.description: This Pokémon's metal exoskeleton requires constant mental energy to maintain. At the start of this Pokémon's turn in combat, it loses VP equal to its proficiency bonus. Additionally, this Pokémon becomes weak to psychic type damage, and whenever it takes psychic damage, it also loses VP equal to the HP damage taken.

abilities.name: Eternal Radiance
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to blindness. Creatures that look directly at it must make a CON save or be blinded for 1 round. Additionally, it can manipulate light as an action to create illusions, reveal invisible creatures, or temporarily blind enemies in a 60 ft radius. Finally, at the start of its turn, this Pokémon restores 1d8 HP to all allies within 30 ft. This healing is enhanced near sources of magical or ancient light.

effects.note: Stronger near magical or ancient light.
Creatures looking directly at it: CON save or blinded for 1 round. Action: illusions, reveal invisible creatures, or blind enemies in a 60 ft radius.

abilities.name: Ether Dawn
abilities.description: This Pokémon radiates ether energy. All damage dealt by this Pokémon is rolled with advantage. However, every time it uses a move, roll a d20. On a roll of 1, it enters into the Ether Overload status condition. On any other result, the Ether Overload count increases by 1. When the Ether Overload passes, this Pokémon loses 1d4 levels. If levels go beyond 1, this Pokémon dies.

effects.note: Roll a d20: on a 1 it gets Ether Overload, otherwise the overload count goes up by 1. When the overload passes it loses 1d4 levels; below level 1 it dies.

review.question: What does the Ether Overload status do, how long does it last, and what does the count increasing by 1 lead to?

abilities.name: Ether Mirror
abilities.description: Ranged move attacks against this Pokémon are reflected back at the attacker after a successful hit. All damage and effects rolled apply to the attacker.

effects.note: All damage and effects rolled apply to the attacker instead.

abilities.name: Fairy Aura
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is in battle, all fairy-type moves by other creatures within 100 feet of it deal double their damage.

effects.note: "By other creatures" -- its own fairy moves are not doubled.

review.question: "Fairy moves by OTHER creatures" are doubled (not its own), while Dark Aura says "allies or opponents". Intentional?

abilities.name: Fairy Breath
abilities.description: All breath moves deal fairy-type damage.

abilities.name: Fairy Wings
abilities.description: Flying-type moves deal fairy-type damage.

abilities.name: Ferocity
abilities.description: When this Pokémon's hit points falls below 50% of its maximum, VP costs for attacking moves are doubled, and all successful attacks deal an additional 2d6 + proficiency bonus damage. When it falls below 25%, VP cost is tripled, and bonus damage increases to 4d6 + proficiency bonus.

abilities.name: Filter
abilities.description: When hit by a move type this Pokémon is vulnerable to, it may roll a d4. In a result of 4, it does not take the additional damage.

abilities.name: Filter System
abilities.description: As an action, this Pokémon may attempt to cure a status condition for itself or a creature it can touch by making a successful medicine check. If successful, this Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP. This ability may be used three times per long rest.

effects.note: Only when the medicine check succeeds; shares the 3 uses above.

abilities.name: Fireproof
abilities.description: This Pokémon covers itself in a web of fire retardant silk fiber that grants resistance to fire damage. When hit by a fire move, roll 1d4. On a 1, the web is burnt away. On any other result, this Pokémon retains its resistance to fire. On subsequent rolls, the result that burns away the web increases by 1. Resets on a long rest.

effects.note: Roll 1d4: on a 1 the web burns away (resistance lost). Each later roll burns it on one more number. Resets on a long rest.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.description: The flames from this Pokémon's body shine dim light in a 15 ft radius. In addition, when hit by a melee attack, roll a d10. On a 10, the attacker is burned.

effects.note: Sheds dim light in a 15 ft radius.

abilities.name: Flare Boost
abilities.description: This Pokémon adds proficiency to its damage rolls while burned.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: This Pokémon takes no damage from fire or fire-type attacks. Instead, immediately after taking a hit from a fire-type move, or in open flames, double the STAB bonus on the next fire type move. While this ability's damage boost is active, this Pokémon's fire attacks ignore resistance.

effects.note: Also triggered by standing in open flames.

abilities.name: Flower Gift
abilities.description: During harsh sunlight, ally Pokémon within 30 feet of this Pokémon add their proficiency bonus to damage rolls.

effects.note: Each ally adds its OWN proficiency bonus.

abilities.name: Flower Mimic
abilities.description: This Pokémon can spend 1 minute changing its appearance to match any common flower. Requires a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to identify it as a Pokémon while mimicking.

abilities.name: Flower Veil
abilities.description: Any grass-type ally within 15 feet of this Pokémon is immune to new status effects, and grass-type allies within the range also have advantage on saving throws.

effects.note: Only NEW conditions -- ones already on the ally stay.

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.description: This Pokemon is vulnerable to fire-type moves, but takes half damage from any melee attack (that isn't fire-type).

abilities.name: Forecast
abilities.description: This Pokémon changes form with the weather. In rain it becomes water-type, in harsh sunlight it becomes fire-type, in cold and snowy conditions it becomes ice-type. In all other conditions it is normal-type. Its STAB, resistance, immunities, and vulnerabilities change to match the form it takes.

effects.note: Cold and snowy conditions also make it Ice.

abilities.name: Forest Blessing
abilities.description: Active effect: This Pokémon can heal a plant or grass type Pokémon for 2d4 HP + its Wisdom modifier as an action. At level 5, the healing dice changes to 2d6, 2d8 at level 10, and 2d12 at level 17. This ability may be used three times per long rest. Passive effect: Plants within 20 ft grow more vigorously and are resistant to disease.

effects.note: Plant or grass-type Pokemon.
Passive: plants within 20 ft grow more vigorously and resist disease.

abilities.name: Forest Sovereign
abilities.description: This Pokémon commands plants and plant-based creatures. Plants will part to create paths and can be commanded to entangle foes.

abilities.name: Forewarn
abilities.description: When this Pokémon enters battle, it selects a target to reveal the move it knows with the most damage output. In the case of a tie, the target can choose which move it reveals.

effects.note: On a tie, the target chooses which one it reveals.

abilities.name: Formation Leader
abilities.description: Allies of this Pokémon may stand in formation with it. This Pokémon may use a bonus action to enter formation with 5 + half its level creatures of large size or smaller, that each are within 5 feet of the next. A formation must consist of at least 5 individuals. While in formation, all creatures gain advantage on Strength saves, and AC is increased by 2. To maintain formation, everyone's movement is held until the Formation Leader moves the entire formation, unless an individual wants to break it. This effect will not stack with more creatures with the same ability. The formation breaks if a gap is created between individuals.

effects.note: Formation: 5 + half its level creatures (Large or smaller, at least 5) each within 5 ft of the next. They only move when the leader moves them; a gap breaks it. Does not stack.

abilities.name: Forme Change
abilities.description: Deoxys can change between its four forms as a bonus action.

effects.note: Deoxys switches between its four forms.

abilities.name: Fortune's Favor
abilities.description: This pokémon gains a number of Luck Points equal to half their level. Every time they or their trainer, as long as this pokémon is active, rolls a 1, they may spend a Luck Point to re-roll that die.

effects.note: Luck points: spend one when it or its trainer rolls a 1 to reroll that die.

abilities.name: Freezing Aura
abilities.description: The very air around this creature is freezing. When ending itsturn within 30ft. of this creature, any creature that is not immune to being frozen is forced to make a dc12 CON save, becoming frozen on a failure.

effects.note: Creatures immune to frozen are skipped.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.description: Once per long rest, when an ally within 15 feet of this Pokémon is hit by an attack, it may choose to halve the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Frigid Aura
abilities.description: Enemies that start their turn within 10 feet of this Pokémon have their speed reduced by 10 feet. Enemies making melee attacks against this Pokémon must succeed a CON save or become slowed (half speed, -2 AC) until the end of their next turn.

effects.note: DC not given -- see review.

review.question: The CON save against becoming slowed has no DC. What is it?

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: Upon entering a battle, a single opponent’s held item is revealed, if it has one.

abilities.name: Full Metal Body
abilities.description: Other Pokémon's moves or abilities cannot lower this Pokémon stats.

abilities.name: Fur Coat
abilities.description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon may halve the damage dealt to it from any one attack.

abilities.name: Gale Wings
abilities.description: This Pokémon adds an additional +1 to hit when using flying type attacks.

abilities.name: Galvanize
abilities.description: All of this Pokémon's normal-type moves are electric-type. When this Pokémon deals electric damage, it stores a charge. After 3 charges, its next electric attack deals double damage, costs double VP and consumes all charges. A charge lasts for 1 minute, whlie in combat.

effects.note: Electric damage stores a charge (lasts 1 minute in combat); at 3 charges the next electric attack deals double damage, costs double VP and uses them all.

abilities.name: Gemcrafter
abilities.description: This Pokémon can consume gems, changing its secondary type changes to the type of the gem it consumed.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.description: This Pokémon must eat its held berry when it falls below ½ of its maximum HP.

abilities.name: Gooey
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit with a melee attack, roll 1d4. On a result of 4, the attacker's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Grass Pelt
abilities.description: This Pokémon gains +1 to AC while in grassy terrain.

abilities.name: Grassy Surge
abilities.description: If the move is known, this Pokémon may use the Grassy Terrain move as a bonus action.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: Gravity is stronger in a 100ft. radius around you. Flying speed is halved, and maintaining flight requires 20VP per turn. Rock-type moves deal 50% more damage, rounded down.

effects.note: Rounded down.
Staying airborne in the area costs 20 VP per turn.

abilities.name: Great Archive
abilities.description: This Pokémon can permanently learn one ability it has recorded. If it loses consciousness, it loses 1d4 of its permanent records, except when healed at a PokéCenter. If this Pokémon faints due to fire damage, it loses 1d12 of its permanent records. This ability can be used once per long rest.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is burned or poisoned, they are not affected by the disadvantage or reduced damage effects. They still take damage at the end of each of their turns.

effects.note: Ignores the disadvantage / reduced damage of burned and poisoned; still takes their end-of-turn damage.

abilities.name: Hard Worker
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on Constitution saving throws against exhaustion from manual labor. Can work twice as long as other Pokémon before requiring rest.

abilities.name: Harvest
abilities.description: At the end of this Pokémon's turn, if it used a berry, roll 1d4. On a result of 3 or 4, it regains that berry as a held item.

effects.note: Gets the berry back as its held item.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.description: As an action, this Pokemon may touch a creature to heal poison, burn, or paralysis. When it uses this ability, roll a d4. On the a result of 1 or 2, the status effect is moved to itself.

effects.note: Then roll a d4: on 1-2 the cured condition moves to this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Healing Rain
abilities.description: This Pokémon can use its action to heal hit points equal to its level, in rainy conditions.

abilities.name: Heatproof
abilities.description: This Pokemon takes half the damage it otherwise would from Fire damage, and is immune to the burning condition.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.description: This Pokémon is especially heavy. Once per long rest, after being targeted by an attack, it may increase its AC by 2 if it would cause an attack to miss.

effects.note: Only worth using when +2 AC turns the hit into a miss.

abilities.name: Hematophage
abilities.description: When this Pokémon deals melee damage, it regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Honey Gather
abilities.description: At the end of each battle, this Pokémon may roll a d20. On a result of 20, its trainer adds a Honey to its inventory

abilities.name: Honorable
abilities.description: After hitting level 10, as long as it has 50% or more of its max HP, this Pokémon does half damage against creatures below level 10. Attacks against other Pokémon do an additional 1d12 + proficiency modifier typeless damage.

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon may double the damage it does on a single move that requires an attack roll. The player must announce that they are using this ability before the attack roll.

effects.note: Must be announced before the attack roll.

abilities.name: Hustle
abilities.description: When you score a critical hit, you may immediately gain an additional action on your turn. If this action is used to make an attack, you have disadvantage on the roll. You may only ever have one additional action per round.

effects.note: An attack made with that action has disadvantage.

abilities.name: Hydra's Resilience
abilities.description: At the start of this Pokémon's turn, it may regain equal to 1d4 times its level. If it is suffering from a status condition, it may not regenerate health. It instead has to roll a DC 15 Constitution save, healing from the status contidion on a success, and gaining 1d4 rounds of immunity to status conditions.

effects.note: On a success it also gets immunity to conditions for 1d4 rounds (next entry).

abilities.name: Hydration
abilities.description: This Pokémon is unaffected by negative status ailments in water or during rainy conditions.

abilities.name: Hyper Cutter
abilities.description: This Pokémon’s attack or damage bonuses cannot be decreased by an opponent’s moves.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.description: While it is snowing or hailing, this Pokémon heals for an amount of HP equal to its proficiency modifier at the end of each of its turns.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.description: This Pokémon knows the Daylight move and can cast a light that exudes bright light for 15ft, and dim light for an additional 15ft, at will.

abilities.name: Illusion
abilities.description: This Pokémon can take the visual form of any Pokémon it can see. It can do this a number of times per long rest equal to its level. This illusion lasts for one hour or until the Pokémon is hit by a damaging move.

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to becoming poisoned.

abilities.name: Imperial Authority
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on intimidation and persuation checks, and may use an action to automatically frighten enemies that can see it for 1d4 rounds. Additionally, three times per long rest, this Pokémon may use its bonus action to override the ability of another Pokémon it can see.

review.question: What does "override the ability of another Pokemon" mean -- suppress it, or replace it with something?

abilities.name: Imperion's Honor
abilities.description: This Pokémon can be wielded as a +3 greatsword, dealing 3d6 + STR steel type damage. While equipped, grants the wielder proficiency in longswords if they don't already have it. When wielded, grants +3 AC, and allows the user to channel the Pokémon's moves as a bonus action, using the Pokémon's ability scores. Additionally, the wielder gains immunity to ghost type damage. It can also manifest a spectral cape behind its wielder, granting it advantage on intimidation rolls. If separated from its chosen wielder, will teleport back to them as a bonus action. While bonded, trainer and Pokémon can communicate telepathically within 240 feet. If the trainer is knocked unconscious, this Pokémon automatically detaches and fights to protect them.

abilities.name: Imposter
abilities.description: This Pokémon can use Transform as a bonus action.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Body
abilities.description: This Pokémon may move through solid walls. Walls are considered difficult terrain. While inside a wall, this Pokémon may still be targeted by moves, taking half damage. Entering a wall costs 5VP, and an additional 5VP at the start of every turn while inside the wall.

effects.note: Moves through walls (difficult terrain). Inside a wall it takes half damage. Entering costs 5 VP, plus 5 VP at the start of each turn inside.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: This Pokémon bypasses Light Screen and Reflect, and its attacks ignore resistance when targeting sleeping or frightened foes.

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a damaging move, the attacker takes an amount of typeless damage equal to the amount of HP lost.

effects.note: Equal to the HP it lost to that move.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to flinching.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to sleep.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: Once per short rest, you can impose disadvantage on an enemy attack roll of your choice.

abilities.name: Iron Barbs
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, it may roll a d4. On a 4, deal an amount of damage equal to its proficiency modifier to its attacker.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.description: When attacking with a punch-based move (Mega Punch, Dynamic Punch, Ice/Fire/Thunder Punch, etc.), this Pokémon may roll the damage twice and choose either total.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a dark-type move, it gets advantage on its next attack.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: This Pokémon ignores disadvantage when it relates to sight.

abilities.name: Klutz
abilities.description: This Pokémon cannot hold an item.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.description: This Pokémon does not suffer from any negative status ailments in harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Legion's Honor
abilities.description: This Pokémon can be wielded as a +1 short sword, dealing 1d6 + STR/DEX steel type damage. While equipped, grants the wielder proficiency in shortswords if they don't already have it. When wielded, grants +1 AC, and allows the user to channel the Pokémon's moves as a bonus action, using the Pokémon's ability scores. If separated from its chosen wielder, will teleport back to them as a bonus action. While bonded, trainer and Pokémon can communicate telepathically within 60 feet. If the trainer is knocked unconscious, this Pokémon automatically detaches and fights to protect them.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to ground moves.

abilities.name: Light Armor
abilities.description: This Pokémon takes 25% reduced damage from super effective moves, rounded down.

effects.note: Rounded down.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.description: If this Pokemon or an ally within 30 feet is targeted with a direct electric-type, damage-dealing move, the Pokemon may use a reaction to redirect the target to itself and take half damage from it if it hits.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to being paralyzed.

abilities.name: Liquid Ooze
abilities.description: If an enemy uses a leeching or absorb move against this Pokémon, the Pokémon must make a DC 12 CON save or become poisoned.

effects.note: Leeching / absorbing moves.

abilities.name: Liquid Voice
abilities.description: Any sound-based move activated by this Pokémon is watertype.

abilities.name: Living Wall
abilities.description: This Pokémon may spend a day to take root in a solid surface. While rooted, the following effects take hold: This Pokémon's speed becomes 0, it can't be recalled into a Pokéball, and it automatically fails DEX saving throws. It gains HP depending on the type of surface (DMs discretion), and has advantage on STR and CON saving throws. While rooted, Mossling may merge with this Pokémon to cause it to grow larger. For every size it grows to above Large, it deals an additional 2d8 damage when using moves. It can spend another day to uproot itself.

abilities.name: Long Reach
abilities.description: This Pokémon has an additional 5 feet of reach with all melee attacks and Attacks of Opportunity

effects.note: Melee attacks and attacks of opportunity.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.description: Once per long rest, when succumbing to a negative status effect, this Pokémon can instead reflect the effect back on the attacker.

abilities.name: Magic Guard
abilities.description: If this Pokémon is subjected to a move that forces it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage on a success.

abilities.name: Magician
abilities.description: If not already holding an item, this Pokémon steals the held item of any Pokémon it hits with a melee attack.

abilities.name: Magma Armor
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to freezing.

abilities.name: Magnet Pull
abilities.description: Steel opponents in battle with this Pokémon may not switch out or flee. This Pokémon's electric attacks deal bonus damage equal to its proficiency bonus to steel-type targets.

effects.note: All steel opponents in battle.

abilities.name: Magnetic Polarity
abilities.description: When hit by an electric-type move, roll a d4. On a 1, this Pokémon takes damage as usual. On 2-3, the damage is split between HP and VP. On a 4, damage taken is added to this Pokémon's next damaging move as bonus electric damage.

effects.note: Takes the damage as usual.
Added to its next damaging move as bonus electric damage.

abilities.name: Maritime Prowler
abilities.description: Water and dark type moves made by this Pokémon cause flinching on natural attack rolls of 18 or more.

abilities.name: Marvel Scale
abilities.description: This Pokémon's AC increase by 2 when suffering from a negative status condition.

abilities.name: Mega Launcher
abilities.description: Aura and Pulse moves made by this Pokémon deal additional damage equal to this Pokémon's proficiency bonus.

abilities.name: Merciless
abilities.description: This Pokémon doubles their damage dice when dealing damage to an opponent that is poisoned.

abilities.name: Mercury's Blessing
abilities.description: This pokémon may use the move Thief as a bonus action.

abilities.name: Mimic
abilities.description: This Pokémon may assume the form of any object it has seen. Any creature that attempts to interact with this Pokémon will be ambushed.

abilities.name: Mineral Refinery
abilities.description: Once per long rest, you may spend 50 VP in order to attempt to craft an evolution stone, proper materials are needed as well. 1: Dawn Stone 2: Dusk Stone 3: Fire Stone 4: Ice Stone 5: Leaf Stone 6: Moon Stone 7: Shiny Stone 8: Sun Stone 9: Thunder Stone 10: Water Stone 11: Dawn Stone 12: Dusk Stone 13: Fire Stone 14: Ice Stone 15: Leaf Stone 16: Moon Stone 17: Shiny Stone 18: Sun Stone 19: Thunder Stone 20: Water Stone

abilities.name: Mischief Maker
abilities.description: Each new round of initiative, this Pokémon may take its turn whenever it wants.

effects.note: Each round it may take its turn whenever it wants.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.description: This Pokémon's moves ignore any abilities or moves that would lessen their effect or ability to hit an opponent (Due to things like Water Absorb, Snow Cloak, Thick Fat, etc.)

effects.note: Abilities that would lessen its moves or their chance to hit.

abilities.name: Molten Armor
abilities.description: When exposed to extreme heat, as in being hit with a fire-type attack or being sprayed by lava, this Pokémon's exterior becomes superheated for 1 round. While superheated, all melee attacks deal 1d6 + proficiency bonus as additional fire damage. The damage for this effect increases with 1d6 at every odd numbered level above 10.

effects.note: Read as its own melee attacks -- see review. Also lava.

review.question: While superheated, is the extra fire damage on ITS melee attacks, or on melee attacks made against it?

abilities.name: Moody
abilities.description: At the end of each long rest, this Pokémon rerolls on the nature table, replacing its nature with the result until the next long rest.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.description: When hit by an electric-type move, if not immune, this Pokémon's speed increases by 10 feet until the end of combat (up to a max of 50 additional feet).

effects.note: Only if not immune to the hit.

abilities.name: Moxie
abilities.description: Upon causing an opponent to faint, this Pokémon may immediately take another action.

abilities.name: Multiple Heads
abilities.description: This Pokémon's many heads are specialized to different move types. At the start of this Pokémon's turn, it chooses an active head, and gains its type as a secondary type for the next round. If one head takes more than 25 damage a single turn, it dies. At the end of this Pokémon's next turn, it may roll a 1d6 for every head it has lost as a bonus action, regrowing one lost head on a 5, or two heads on a 6.

effects.note: Start of turn: choose an active head, gaining its type as a secondary type for the round. A head taking 25+ damage in one turn dies; end of next turn, bonus action: 1d6 per lost head, regrow one on a 5, two on a 6.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.description: If this Pokémon is at full health, the first damage dealt to it is halved.

abilities.name: Multitype
abilities.description: This Pokémon's type and form change to match the type of Elemental Plate this Pokémon holds. The Plate cannot be effected by any item-removing ability or move.

effects.note: The plate cannot be removed by any ability or move.

abilities.name: Mummy
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, one random ability of its attacker changes to Mummy until the remainder of the encounter.

abilities.name: Mystical Presence
abilities.description: This Pokémon may use its Charisma modifier instead of the regular modifier for all saving throws.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.description: This Pokémon is cured of negative status ailments upon returning to its Pokeball.

abilities.name: Negating Cone
abilities.description: The beholder's central eye creates an area of energy nullification, in a 150-foot cone. As a bonus action, the beholder decides which way the cone faces and whether the cone is active. All moves that are not normal type are negated within the affected area. The beholder's moves are not affected by this.

effects.note: Bonus action: aim the cone and switch it on or off. Moves other than normal-type are negated inside it; the beholder's own moves aren't.

abilities.name: Neuroforce
abilities.description: When this Pokémon damages a creature with a super effective move, it may roll the damage dice twice and use the higher result.

abilities.name: Night Watch
abilities.description: During the night or in darkness, this Pokémon's lantern creates a 15ft radius of dim light around it. This light grants this Pokémon +1/3 AC and +7 to STR and DEX saving throws. Within the range of its lantern, immunity to ghost type damage is negated.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.description: Any attack made by or against this Pokémon has advantage.

abilities.name: Noble Presence
abilities.description: At the beginning of each turn during initiative, this Pokémon can grant advantage on one roll to an ally within 60ft.

review.question: "At the beginning of each turn during initiative" -- each of its own turns, or every creature's turn?

abilities.name: Normalize
abilities.description: Every move this Pokémon activates is Normal type.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to moves that attempt to charm or taunt it.

abilities.name: Ossein Hunter
abilities.description: This Pokémon can feed on a creature's remains as a bonus action, gaining 1d10 + its Wisdom modifier as temporary HP. This temporary HP lasts until the end of its next long rest. It can feed on a single target's remains one time + one more per size level above tiny. This effect caps out when the pool of temporary HP is equal to 50% of its max HP.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.description: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather-related moves like Hail, Weather Ball, etc.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.description: When this Pokémon falls below 25% of its maximum HP, add 50% more dice to damage rolls for its grass-type moves, and damaging water moves cost 50% more VP.

effects.note: The dex text says WATER moves cost more -- a typo for grass (user's call, 2026-10-08).

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to becoming confused

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on attack rolls against a target if an ally is within 5ft. of it.

abilities.name: Paper Thin
abilities.description: This Pokémon is vulnerable to fire damage, and critical hit against this Pokémon always deals max damage.

abilities.name: Peace Aura
abilities.description: At the beginning of each turn, hostile creatures within 30ft. must succeed a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of their next turn.

effects.note: Until the start of THEIR next turn. DC not given -- see review.

review.question: No save DC is given. What is it (e.g. 8 + proficiency + WIS)? And "at the beginning of each turn" -- each of this Pokemon's turns, or each creature's turn?

abilities.name: Perfect Memory
abilities.description: After witnessing a creature use an action, bonus action, or reaction, this Pokémon can use its reaction to record that ability. It can record three abilities per long rest, and will lose all recorded abilities if it loses consciousness. The process of healing at a PokéCenter will also wipe these records.

abilities.name: Phantom Body
abilities.description: Once per short rest, when this pokemon would be reduced to 0 HP, it instead becomes incorporeal until the start of its next turn. While incorporeal, it can't attack and is immune to physical damage. It reappears with HP equal to its level, in an unstable form, and can't be safely held in a Poké Ball until it has finished a long rest.

effects.note: Can't attack; immune to physical damage.
Reappears with HP equal to its level; can't be safely held in a Poke Ball until a long rest.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.description: As a bonus action, this Pokémon can make a DEX check contested by the opponent’s WIS to attempt to steal a held item. After the first attempt, all other attempts against the same opponent are rolled at disadvantage.

effects.note: After the first attempt, further attempts on the same opponent are at disadvantage.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.description: If an opponent uses a consumable held item in battle, this Pokémon gains a copy of it if it is not currently holding an item.

abilities.description: This Pokémon boosts its attack and damage rolls by 2 if an ally also has a Plus or Minus ability

abilities.description: On melee attacks made by this Pokémon, roll a d10 on a hit. On a result of a 10, the target is poisoned.

abilities.name: Pollinator
abilities.description: This Pokémon can detect flowering plants within 30 feet. Has advantage on Survival checks to find plants and water sources.

abilities.name: Potential
abilities.description: Once per day, this Pokémon may change its secondary type by spending a short rest absorbing energy from a type gem.

abilities.name: Powder Master
abilities.description: Powder moves made by this Pokémon increase their saving throw DC by the user's level.

abilities.name: Power Surge
abilities.description: This Pokémon takes no damage from electricity or electric-type attacks. Instead, immediately after taking a hit from a electric-type move, or in an electric current, double the STAB bonus on the next electric type move.

effects.note: Also triggered by being in an electric current.

abilities.name: Praetorian Guard
abilities.description: This Pokémon may take hits for allies that are within its range of movement. If an ally in range is targeted by an attack, this Pokémon may spend unspent movement to move next to its ally out of turn without provoking attacks of opportunity. The attack against the ally will be rolled against this Pokémon's AC instead of the intended target.

effects.note: Ally within its unspent movement; it moves next to the ally out of turn without provoking, and the attack is rolled against ITS AC.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon can move to the top of initiative order in a single round, but must use a statusaffecting move on its turn.

effects.note: Must use a status-affecting move on that turn.

abilities.name: Predator
abilities.description: During a long rest, this Pokémon may assign a creature it knows about as Prey. Double proficiency bonus is added to attack rolls, and damage rolls are done with advantage against Prey creatures.

effects.note: Double proficiency = one extra proficiency bonus. Prey is chosen during a long rest.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.description: Any move targeting this Pokémon directly (non-area of effect moves) reduces its VP by double when activated.

effects.note: Single-target moves only (not area of effect).

abilities.name: Prey Stalker
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on attack rolls against all creatures that are one or more levels smaller than itself, and rolls damage against these creatures twice, taking the higher result.

abilities.name: Primordial Shift
abilities.description: At the beginning of every round of combat, you may draw on ancient power to change your type to that of either psychic, dark, water, ground or dragon.

abilities.name: Prism Armor
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is subject to damage in its vulnerabilities list, roll the damage dice twice and use the lower result for the damage calculation.

abilities.name: Proper Form
abilities.description: When attacked, this Pokémon can impose disadvantage on an attack roll, correcting the attacker's "improper form".

effects.note: No use limit in the text -- read as costing its reaction.

review.question: No use limit. Does it cost the reaction each time, or is it limited (once per round / short rest)?

abilities.name: Protean
abilities.description: This Pokémon's primary type changes to the type of move it uses, just before the move is used. It takes on the new type's resistances, vulnerabilities, and immunities.

effects.note: Changes just BEFORE the move is used (so it gets STAB).

abilities.name: Protector
abilities.description: If an allied creature in a lower stage of the same family as this Pokémon is in danger, this Pokémon gains +5 to its attack rolls and adds its proficiency bonus to all damage dealt (once per move).

while.text: a lower-stage ally of its own family is in danger
a lower-stage ally of its own family is in danger

effects.note: Once per move.

abilities.description: At the start of each turn, this Pokémon gains temporary HP equal to its INT modifier + proficiency bonus. This stacks up to a maximum equal to 2x its level.

abilities.name: Psychic Boost
abilities.description: This Pokémon treats using psychic type moves as if it had the psychic type.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon may double the damage it does on a single move that requires an attack roll. The player must announce that they are using this ability before the attack roll.

effects.note: Must be announced before the attack roll.

abilities.name: Pure Waters
abilities.description: Damaging water moves used by other creatures within 50ft of this Pokémon have their secondary effects removed, but deal 20% more damage, rounded down.

effects.note: Rounded down.

abilities.name: Queen Majesty
abilities.description: Bonus action moves activated by any creature within sight of this Pokémon become standard actions.

effects.note: Any creature it can see.

abilities.description: When suffering from a negative status condition, this Pokémon’s speed increases by 15 ft.

abilities.description: This Pokémon provides light in a 20ft. radius, adjustable as a bonus action. Additionally, it can absorb light sources within 30ft. as a bonus action, gaining 1d12 temporary HP, but having disadvantage on stealth checks until the temporary HP is gone.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.description: In rainy conditions, this Pokémon heals for an amount of HP equal to its proficiency bonus at the end of each of its turns.

abilities.name: Ram
abilities.description: If this Pokémon has charges for at least 15ft. going into a melee attack, it has advantage on the attack and damage rolls.

abilities.name: Rattled
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a damaging Dark, Bug, or Ghost move, it makes its next attack at advantage.

abilities.name: Reality Ripper
abilities.description: This Pokémon's slashing attacks ignore resistances and immunities and can hit creatures in the Ethereal Plane.

effects.note: Can hit creatures in the Ethereal Plane.

abilities.name: Reality Weaver
abilities.description: When Jirachi's third eye is open, it can manipulate probability in a 60-foot radius. As a reaction, it can force a reroll on any d20 roll made within this area.

effects.note: Any d20 roll made in the area.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.description: When attacking with moves with recoil damage, this Pokémon doubles its STAB bonus.

abilities.name: Refrigerate
abilities.description: All of this Pokémon's normal-type moves become ice-type. Additionally, ice-type moves freeze water surfaces and create difficult terrain in a 10ft radius around the target.

abilities.description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon regains hit points equal to its level when it returns to its Pokéball.

abilities.description: This Pokémon has Resistance to Normal and Steel-type damage, and gains a +2 AC bonus when defending a location it has maintained for at least one day Immunity to being moved against its will while standing on ground it has cleaned.

abilities.description: As an action, this Pokémon can emit light in a 60 ft radius that dispels illusions and reveals invisible creatures by succeeding a Charisma check (GM discretion).

abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, it may roll a d4. On a 4, deal an amount of damage equal to its proficiency modifier to its attacker.

abilities.description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon can issue a command that creatures within 30 ft must obey unless they succeed on a WIS save.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.description: This Pokémon cannot be the target of an attack of opportunity.

abilities.name: Saline Syntesis
abilities.description: While in water, or during rainfall, this Pokémon is resistant to all damage types it is not naturally weak to, and takes no additional damage from types it is weak to. If submerged in salt water, this Pokemon regenerates 1/16 HP every turn.

abilities.name: Salvager
abilities.description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon can make a survival check to spend a minute to attempt temporarily increase AC between 1 and 3 points, based on available materials in the environment. This AC increase lasts until it takes a hit.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.description: During a Sandstorm, this Pokémon can double its STAB when it hits an opponent.

abilities.name: Sand Rush
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to Sandstorm damage, and its speed is doubled in desert terrain, or during a Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sand Stream
abilities.description: When this Pokémon enters an outside battle, the weather immediately changes to a Sandstorm for 5 rounds. In the case of another Pokémon with a similar weather ability, the tie goes to the Pokémon with the highest DEX score.

effects.name: Sandstorm

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to Sandstorm damage. In addition, its AC increases by 2 in desert terrain, or during a Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.description: This Pokémon takes no damage from grass-type attacks. If hit by a grass type move, it takes no damage and instead absorbs the energy, granting advantage on its next attack.

abilities.name: Schooling
abilities.description: Beginning at level 5, this Pokémon may change to School Form as a free action when it begins its turn above 25% of its maximum health. In School Form, the Pokémon adds 5 to its AC and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution ability scores (Additional CON does not alter this Pokemon's HP in this form). The Pokémon reverts back to Solo Form when it falls below 25% of maximum health, and must complete a short rest before activating this ability again.

effects.note: School Form. The extra CON doesn't change its HP.

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.description: This Pokémon's Normal and Fighting type moves hit Ghost type Pokémon.

abilities.name: Seasonal Coat
abilities.description: During winter months, this Pokémon gains resistance to ice damage and has advantage on stealth checks in their natural environment. In summer months, it gains resistance to fire damage, and has advantage on Constitution checks.

abilities.name: Sedative Spines
abilities.description: Any creature coming into physical contact with this Pokémon needs to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, or become drowsy for 1d4 minutes. While drowsy, the creature suffers disadvantage on saving throws and attack rolls, and other craetures have advantage on saving throws induced by this Pokémon. At the end of the drowsiness, the creature becomes unconscious for 1d12 hours. For the duration, the creature can't be awakened by normal means unless it completes a long rest. They are, however, considered asleep, and can be damaged by Bad Dreams, Dream Eater or similar moves.

effects.note: Drowsy: disadvantage on saves and attack rolls, others get advantage on saves it causes. When it ends: unconscious (counts as asleep) for 1d12 hours, only a long rest wakes it.

abilities.name: Self-Destructor
abilities.description: Upon being reduced to 0 HP, this Pokémon activates the move Self-Destruct as if it had full HP, at no cost.

effects.note: Used as if it had full HP, at no cost.

abilities.description: This Pokémon can't unwillingly fall asleep.

abilities.description: Creatures within 50 feet of this Pokémon may not flee or switch out, except by item, Move, or ability.

effects.note: Can still leave by item, move or ability.

abilities.description: When in dim light or darkness, This Pokémon gains a +2 bonus to AC.

abilities.description: If this Pokémon is affected by a negative status ailment, they can roll a d4 at the end of each of their turns. On a result of 4, they are cured.

abilities.description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon can ignore a negative status condition that results from an enemy move.

abilities.name: Snow Cloak
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to Hail damage. It's AC is increased by 2 in arctic conditions, or when it is snowing or hailing.

effects.note: Bonus action: coat an ally's weapon with the same bonus for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Soul-Heart
abilities.description: Upon seeing an ally faint, this Pokémon increases the ability scores of its saving throw proficiencies by 2 until the end of combat. This is stackable up to a maximum of +10 to any one ability score.

effects.note: The ability scores of its saving-throw proficiencies; max +10 to any one score.

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to sound-based moves.

abilities.name: Spectral Sight
abilities.description: As an action, this Pokémon can see into the Depths of Twilight, and detect the presence of ghosts and spirits within 30 ft.

abilities.description: While this Pokémon is active and in an environment related to its type (DM Discretion), its trainer gets advantage on initiative rolls.

effects.note: Dying creatures within 15 ft can talk to it; reaction: change the outcome of a death saving throw.

abilities.description: When an opponent is switched out in battle, this Pokémon doubles the damage dealt if it targets the replacement on the first turn immediately following the switch.

effects.note: Only against the replacement, on its first turn after the switch.

abilities.name: Stall
abilities.description: This Pokémon is always last in initiative order.

abilities.name: Stamina
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is damaged by a move, increase its AC by 2 until the start of its next turn. This ability does not stack and will remain in effect if the Pokémon is successfully attacked multiple turns in a row.

effects.note: Doesn't stack -- a new hit just refreshes it.

abilities.name: Stance Change
abilities.description: Mossworn has two forms. When Mossworn uses King's Shield, it changes to Shield Forme, swapping its AC and DEX stats. When it uses a damaging move, Mossworn immediately returns to Blade Forme, returning its stats to normal.

effects.note: Shield Forme; a damaging move returns it to Blade Forme.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, roll a d4. On a result of 4, the attacker takes an amount of electric damage equal to this Pokemon's proficiency bonus.

abilities.name: Static Wool
abilities.description: When hit by a melee attack, this Pokémon discharges static electricity. The attacker must succeed a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 electric damage and be shocked, suffering disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Steadfast
abilities.description: Once per long rest, when this Pokémon fails a saving throw against a negative status condition, it can choose to pass instead.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a melee attack, roll a d10. On a 10, the attacker flinches.

abilities.name: Sticky Hold
abilities.description: Held items cannot be stolen or knocked away from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Stone Veil
abilities.description: This Pokémon's AC is increased by 2 in rocky terrain, or during a Sandstorm.

abilities.name: Storm Drain
abilities.description: If this Pokemon or an ally within 30 feet is targeted with a direct water-type, damage-dealing move, the Pokemon may use a reaction to redirect the target to itself and take half damage from it if it hits.

abilities.name: Storm Warning
abilities.description: Has advantage and expertise on nature checks to predict incoming weather.

abilities.name: Strong Jaw
abilities.description: For biting moves activated by this Pokémon (Bite, Thunder Fang, Crunch, etc.), they may roll the damage twice and choose either total.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.description: When taking damage equal to half or more of your current HP, roll a d4. On a result of 3 of 4, halve the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Suction Cups
abilities.description: This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by an opponent’s moves.

abilities.name: Super Luck
abilities.description: This Pokémon increases its critical hit range by 1 (20 to 19+, etc.)

abilities.name: Supervisor
abilities.description: This Pokémon can direct up to 4 Smudgel or other worker Pokémon as a bonus action. Allies within 30 feet gain advantage on ability checks related to their work. Once per long rest, can inspire allies to ignore one level of exhaustion.

abilities.name: Surface Tension
abilities.description: This Pokémon can walk on water, and is immune to any entry hazard effects.

effects.note: Can walk on water.

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.description: When this Pokémon begins its turn in the area of effect from Electric Terrain, its speed is doubled.

abilities.name: Swamp Stalker
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on Stealth checks made while in a swampy environment.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.description: When this Pokémon falls below 25% of its maximum HP, add 50% more dice to damage rolls for its bug-type moves, and damaging bug moves cost 50% more VP.

abilities.name: Sweet Veil
abilities.description: Any ally within 15 feet of this Pokémon is immune to the sleep condition.

abilities.name: Swift Post
abilities.description: When carrying an item, your speed out of combat is increased by 10 feet, and constitution rolls related to travel are done with advantage. Additionally, you have advantage when attempting to flee from battles.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.description: This Pokémon's swim speed is doubled in rainy conditions.

abilities.name: Symbiosis
abilities.description: This Pokémon may swap held items with an ally as a free action, as long as they are within 15 feet of each other.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.description: If this Pokémon becomes burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, its attacker receives the negative status condition as well (even if otherwise immune).

effects.note: The attacker gets the same condition, even if otherwise immune.

abilities.name: Tangling Hair
abilities.description: Opponents within melee range of this Pokémon cannot take the Disengage action to move away.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.description: For damaging moves activated by this Pokémon with a VP cost of 6 or less, they may roll the damage twice and choose either total.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.description: This Pokémon cannot be damaged by its allies' attacks.

abilities.name: Temporal Collapse
abilities.description: When Temporis is reduced to 0 hit points, the temporal wound it embodies begins to unravel. The following effects occur: - A rift in space-time opens in Temporis's space - Each creature within 100 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw - On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 psychic damage and is moved 1d4 × 10 feet in a random direction as time distorts around them - On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't moved - The area within 1000 feet becomes a temporary temporal anomaly zone for 24 hours, where: - Time moves unpredictably - Creatures that end their turn in the zone must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or experience a random temporal effect - The Lorekeepers may be drawn to the area to contain the anomaly

effects.note: Failed save: moved 1d4 x 10 ft in a random direction. The 1000 ft area becomes a temporal anomaly zone for 24 hours.

abilities.name: Teravolt
abilities.description: This Pokémon’s moves completely ignore any ability that would hinder or prevent their effect on the target or the user's ability to hit the target.

effects.note: Abilities that would hinder its moves or their chance to hit.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.description: This Pokemon takes half the damage it otherwise would from Ice and Fire damage.

abilities.name: Time Vision
abilities.description: Temporis exists across multiple moments simultaneously. It has advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, and can't be surprised. Additionally, opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Time Warp
abilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 50 feet of Temporis must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 4d10 psychic damage and has its speed halved until the start of its next turn as it experiences temporal displacement. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and suffers no other effects.

abilities.name: Tinted Lens
abilities.description: This Pokémon’s moves ignore resistances.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: When this Pokémon falls below 25% of its maximum hp, add 50% more dice to damage rolls for its water-type moves, and damaging water moves cost 50% more VP.

abilities.name: Tough Claws
abilities.description: A successful melee attack by this Pokémon automatically gets STAB, regardless of its type. If it would normally get STAB, double the STAB bonus when adding to damage.

effects.note: Gets STAB on a melee hit whatever its type; if it already had STAB, double it.

abilities.name: Toxic Aura
abilities.description: At the start of this Pokémon's turn, it may use the move Smog as a bonus action, costing no VP.

abilities.name: Toxic Boost
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a poison-type attack, its next attack is rolled at advantage.

abilities.name: Toxic Surge
abilities.description: When this Pokémon enters combat, all enemies within 15 feet must make a CON save (DC = 8 + proficiency + CON mod) or become badly poisoned. While an enemy is poisoned, this Pokémon's attacks deal an additional 1d6 + proficiency bonus poison damage.

effects.note: Read as: against a poisoned enemy.

abilities.name: Trace
abilities.description: This Pokémon copies a random ability of an opponent when entering battle. The ability cannot be Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.

abilities.name: Transformer
abilities.description: This Pokémon has a standard Normal form from which all stats are based, but may change forms as a bonus action to drastically change its abilities. The forms it can take are Attack, Defense, and Speed. In Attack form, it adds an additional +5 to its attack rolls, but all attacks against it has advantage. In Defense form, its AC increases by 3, but its attacks are rolled at disadvantage. If the activated move requires a save, the target(s) have advantage. In Speed form, it gains an additional attack action each turn, but the attack is done at disadvantage. If it is a move that requires a save, the target(s) have advantage.

effects.note: An extra attack action each turn, made at disadvantage.

abilities.name: Treasure Hoarder
abilities.description: While travelling, this Pokémon may stumble upon valuable items that it will store inside its shell. When defeated, a character attempting to loot this Pokémon must succeed a DC 8 + level INT check in order to unlock the vault.

abilities.name: Triage
abilities.description: This Pokémon's healing or draining moves have a move time of 1 bonus action.

effects.note: Healing or draining moves.

abilities.name: Truant
abilities.description: This Pokémon cannot use the same move in back to back rounds.

effects.note: Can't use the same move in back-to-back rounds.

abilities.name: Turboblaze
abilities.description: This Pokémon’s moves completely ignore any ability that would hinder or prevent their effect on the target or the user's ability to hit the target.

effects.note: Abilities that would hinder its moves or their chance to hit.

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.description: When this Pokémon attacks an opponent, it ignores any stat boosts the opponent has been affected with after the start of battle. This includes boosts to AC or saving throws the Pokémon has to make.

effects.note: Boosts since the start of battle, including AC and saves.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.description: While this Pokémon is active and not holding an item, its trainer gets advantage on initiative rolls.

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.description: Opponents in combat with this Pokémon must succeed a DC15 Wisdom saving throw in order to consume items.

effects.note: To consume an item.

abilities.name: Vector
abilities.description: After landing a hit, this Pokémon can impose one of the following status conditions after a failed Constitution save: Poisoned, Paralyzed or Slowed (half movement). If the target fails the save by 5 or more, this ability bypasses defenses like Safeguard. The effect lasts until the next long rest.

effects.note: Failing by 5 or more bypasses defences like Safeguard. Slowed here = half movement.

review.question: What is the CON save DC?

abilities.name: Victory Star
abilities.description: While this Pokémon is in battle, all allied Pokémon within 50 feet add an additional +1 to their attack rolls.

effects.note: All allied Pokemon in battle (within 50 ft).

abilities.name: Vital Spirit
abilities.description: This Pokémon cannot be put to sleep.

abilities.name: Void Manifest
abilities.description: This Pokémon may as a free action assume the Void Form or Watcher's Guise. While in Void Form, this Pokémon creates a field of supernatural darkness in a 30ft. radius that nullifies natural light, and dims ether based light. The field moves with the Pokémon. Unless illuminated by ether based light, or otherwise identified, this Pokémon is untargetable. All attacks against this Pokémon while obscured by this darkness are made with disadvantage, and it has advantage on all saving throws caused by AoE moves.

effects.note: Void Form: 30 ft supernatural darkness that moves with it; untargetable unless lit by ether light. Watcher's Guise isn't described.

review.question: What does Watcher's Guise do? Only Void Form is described.

abilities.name: Void Shift
abilities.description: Once per short rest, when this Pokémon would take damage, it can use its reaction to briefly phase out of reality, reducing the damage by half.

abilities.name: Void Traversal
abilities.description: Once per day, Deoxys can transport itself and up to 8 willing creatures within 30 feet to any location on the same plane that Deoxys has previously visited.

abilities.name: Volcanic Shell
abilities.description: When this Pokémon is hit by a meelee attack, it may use its reaction to emit waves of heat that deal fire damage all creatures within 5ft of this Pokémon. Roll damage dice according to this Pokémon's size: Tiny: 1d4, Small: 2d4, Medium: 3d4, Large: 4d4, Huge: 5d4, Gigantic: 6d4.

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.description: This Pokémon takes no damage from electricity or electrictype attacks. Instead, half of any electric damage done is absorbed, restoring the Pokémon's HP.

abilities.name: Warning Chime
abilities.description: This Pokémon can't be surprised. Allies within 60ft. also can't be surprised. After level 10, the range of this ability increases to 100ft.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: This Pokémon takes no damage from water or water-type attacks. Instead, half of any water damage done is absorbed, restoring the Pokémon's HP.

abilities.name: Water Bubble
abilities.description: This Pokémon is resistant to fire-type damage and immune to the burned condition.

abilities.name: Water Compaction
abilities.description: After being damaged by a water-type move, any other damage dealt to this Pokémon until the beginning of its next turn is halved.

effects.note: Any OTHER damage after the water hit.

abilities.name: Water Veil
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to burning.

abilities.name: Water Vein
abilities.description: Using water moves restores 1/16 of this Pokémon's max HP.

abilities.name: Water Weight
abilities.description: Once per short rest, this Pokémon gains temporary hit points equal to its level when battling in coastal and swampy areas, or in rainy conditions.

abilities.name: Weak Armor
abilities.description: When an attack hits this Pokémon, its speed increases by 5 feet, but its AC is temporarily reduced by 1 until the end of battle (for a maximum reduction of -5).

abilities.name: White Smoke
abilities.description: Other Pokémon's moves or abilities cannot lower this Pokémon stats.

abilities.name: Wimp Out
abilities.description: When a damaging move causes this Pokémon to fall below 50% of its maximum HP, it MUST disengage and move up to its speed in a straight line towards its trainer as a free action. If this would put the Pokémon in range of switching out, it must do so as another free action if another Pokémon is available to replace it.

effects.note: MUST disengage and move its speed straight toward its trainer; if that puts it in switching range and another Pokemon is available, it must be switched out.

abilities.name: Winter Roots
abilities.description: This Pokémon gains proficiency with ice-type moves. If an allied creature within 30 feet uses a move that would restore HP based on damage dealt, this Pokémon restores HP equal to 50% of the healing its ally receives.

abilities.name: Wishmaker
abilities.description: Once awake, Jirachi can grant a wish to a creature within 30 feet. Jirachi cannot grant wishes that would directly harm others or drastically alter reality's fundamental nature.

abilities.name: Wonder Guard
abilities.description: This Pokémon is immune to damaging attacks from types that are not in its vulnerabilities list.

abilities.name: Wonder Skin
abilities.description: This Pokémon has advantage on all saving throws against being burned, frozen, poisoned, or paralyzed.

abilities.name: Wreath of Ash
abilities.description: A dark, smoldering aura surrounds this Pokémon. At the start of each of its turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 1d10 + proficiency modifier fire damage. This damage ignores resistance to fire.
